findings.claim: The assessment does not assess the required GitHub release metadata and website-update work for completed Windows and Mac releases.
findings.evidence: Goals require: "Build and publish BOTH Windows x64 and Mac Apple Silicon as essential customer platforms, updating GitHub release metadata and website per completed platform." The only matching assessment entry is G10: "Complete customer releases | User requires both Windows x64 and Apple Silicon; only existing Windows 2.2.0 publication evidence is available. New repairs need fresh payloads/installers and acceptance." This omits any gap analysis for GitHub release metadata or website updates.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an explicit release-publication gap covering GitHub release metadata and website update requirements per platform, including current evidence/location and acceptance needed.
